scope: Requested profile URL restrictions, Individual label, active-connection chat, gallery/resource retirement and authorized generated-result cleanup. Disposable local WordPress; manual installation.
changes: LinkedIn URLs must use linkedin.com; X URLs must use x.com or twitter.com, including legitimate subdomains. Lookalike hosts, credentials and non-default ports are rejected by frontend and backend.
Individual is the displayed label; stored independent codes and legacy labels remain compatible.
Connected pairs override obsolete pending conversation-request states; writable chats show the normal composer.
Galleries and resources support hidden state in the editor and explicit retire/republish actions, with an authorized searchable registry and timestamped actor/reason history.
Hidden content is not accessible through another member catalog or direct URL; scheduling is cancelled when it is retired. Executive ownership restrictions remain enforced.

full_php_preflight.resolution: The new test helper initially sent GET filters as body params and POST data without JSON. Corrected to real query params / JSON. All seven final focused cases passed. This is not described as a new full-suite PASS.

checks: LinkedIn and X domains are validated in the profile UI and on the server
Administration offers Individual and validates social links when editing a member
Active connection ignores a legacy pending chat request and allows composing
gallery: hide, historical registry and republish preserve the record
resource: hide, historical registry and republish preserve the record

fixture_cleanup: Owned services, volumes and private credentials removed.
limitations: No installation or active scan on published hosting.
The previous ZAP and YouTube/CSP reports retain their own historical package hashes; no new full ZAP scan for this change.
